title: Unlocking Burst A
eyebrow: Choice for aj · nothing changed yet

short.lead: Your approvals for Burst A never reached the Focus Deck lock. This session now starts each of your messages in the /home/user folder, which is not a git repo, so the plugin drops them without a word. The lock also refuses any hand edit, so I cannot record them for you.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it changes and what it needs from you.
items: docs/5-today/Today.md on the triage branch says where everything stands, for a fresh session.
The plugin issue "Design-loop approvals are dropped silently" (Ajw2003/AjsClaudeCodeTools#296).
One of the two routes under Choices.

choices: How should Burst A get unlocked?
A new session started on the Focus Deck repo
There you type "Design approved: Burst A"; I create the build-step issues and log the plan; then you type "Build plan approved: Burst A".
Turn the lock off in this session
You set HOUSE_RULES_LOOP=off in the environment settings. Code edits open straight away, with no stage checks.
The new session keeps the lock working as designed and costs only a fresh start, since the handoff note carries everything over.

wrapup.summary: A choice of how to unlock Burst A after this session's approvals were dropped.
wrapup.next: With the new session, Burst A is built there. With the lock off, I restart the builder here.
